plan.understanding: Make the existing vertical obround slot a true through-slot by removing its remaining bottom material so it opens out the opposite side, reducing weight.

subtasks.goal: Convert the upright web’s vertical obround slot into a THROUGH cut by removing the remaining material behind its front pocket floor: use the existing slot profile (keep the same width d=18.0 with r=9.0 ends from the red cylindrical family) and extend the cut along -Z (opposite the +Z normal of floor face #23) until it breaks out of the opposite exterior surface at z=-42.0 (planar face #52, n=[0,0,-1]). This operation should eliminate the internal stop faces #23 (z=-10) and the opposing pocket stop #18 (z=-32) so the slot is open completely through that local body thickness, without changing the slot’s outline on either side.
